verdict_reasoning: The teacher reproduces the training-pipeline held-out metrics EXACTLY and generalizes with near-zero overfitting; the clustered absolute-error peak is largely an absolute-scale effect. HOWEVER, force-scale-normalized fidelity shows a GENUINE relative-fidelity degradation in the oxygen-deficient target domain — worst at dilute vacancy (normalized RMSE 0.262, ~2.2x amorphous), with clustered also elevated (0.155, ~1.3x). Per the task's explicit guidance, absence of a project threshold does NOT imply acceptance; the teacher must be judged on relative fidelity in the intended target domain. Oxygen-deficient SiOx (dilute+clustered vacancies) is the CORE distillation objective, and its relative fidelity is genuinely weaker (not merely scale). Conservatively => TEACHER_REVISE_BEFORE_DISTILLATION: improve the teacher in the oxygen-deficient domain (DFT-anchored / active-learning targeting dilute+clustered vacancies) BEFORE finalizing distillation, OR establish a source-grounded deployment accuracy requirement demonstrating the current oxygen-deficient fidelity is adequate. This supersedes the interim ACCEPT (which had leaned on generalization + no-threshold reasoning).
